# omarchy-eval-oracle

The triage (Config Oracle) procedure. The oracle decides WHAT to test and HOW
— it never runs a bed.

## The output contract

The reply is ONE JSON object with the declared outputs. Every field must be a
real resolved value from the tools — a placeholder in any field fails the
whole lane at render time.

## The triage steps

1. Classify the diff (the venue ladder): system / packaging / visual / skip.
   A draft or WIP PR is class "skip" — never a faked bed.
2. Resolve the PR head sha, the changed files, and the PR's OWN test files
   (the changed test/shell.d/*.sh — never invent tests).
3. Author the checks: each check is a shell assertion (grep/test) that
   PROVES the PR's behavior on the live system at its ABSOLUTE system paths
   (/usr/share/omarchy/..., /etc/..., ~/.config/...). Scripts may not be +x
   after apply: invoke them via their interpreter (bash <abs path>).
4. knownRed is a CONTRACT, not prose: the control bed runs the negated
   assertion on the pristine golden. If the assertion passes without the PR,
   the check is fake and the lane re-renders informed. Author assertions
   that are red by construction: they reference the PR's own added lines.
5. The drive command: ONE shell command that exercises the PR's key behavior
   inside the recording.
